title: Not impressed
text:
Not impressed. I am disappointed at the low amount of air flow. The fans were not used outside in the heat, they were inside a van (white) and windows down under a shade tree. They simply did not put out very much cool air. I had purchased a few so I know this is the fan, not a defect. Would not get them again. These were to keep animals cool but only slight flow of air even on HI.
I would not recommend them.
